shared_tail.surface: محمد بن عبد الرحمن بن سعد بن زرارة الأنصاري

notes: «محمد بن جعفر، غندر» is one link: a comma between a name and its laqab, no «و» (rule 7)
«عمي، يحيى»: the uncle is named by relation plus name, so the link is the name alone
The dashes gloss («وما أدركت رجلا منا…») is an editor's note and is left out; Yahya is the last link since his words are the account
Shu'ba is where the two branches meet; the shared tail runs from Muhammad ibn Abd al-Rahman
